acceptedAnswer.text: A fintech AI PR agency runs earned media strategy for companies building financial products, AI infrastructure or AI-enabled financial services, where regulatory context and technical credibility shape every message. It is the right fit for founders raising from institutional investors, seeking enterprise partnerships or operating in regulated markets who need press coverage that holds up to due-diligence scrutiny. mainEntity.name: How much does fintech or AI PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full-service agencies typically charge $15K–$45K per month because the retainer covers a multi-person account team. A fractional senior operator delivers the same senior strategy and direct editor relationships for $5K–$12K per month. A focused launch sprint, covering positioning, embargo strategy and tiered outreach around a single announcement, runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can you get fintech and AI coverage in?

acceptedAnswer.text: For AI infrastructure and developer tools: Forbes, Decrypt, Benzinga, The Information, VentureBeat, TechCrunch. For fintech and regulated products: Bloomberg, CoinDesk, Yahoo Finance, Finextra, PYMNTS, American Banker. For raises and partnerships with a regional angle: Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA), BloomingBit (Korea). Coverage is earned on the strength of a real news hook pitched to the right editor, not distributed via wire.

mainEntity.name: What does the process look like and how long does it take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first two weeks are a teardown: reviewing your existing press footprint, the regulatory context of your product, your competitive category and the specific story worth pitching now. Week three produces the narrative document and outlet map. Outreach begins in week four, with placements typically appearing within six to ten weeks of the engagement starting. For a launch sprint tied to a specific announcement, embargo management and coordinated outreach can deliver coverage within 24 to 48 hours of an announcement going live.

Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your current press footprint and the most credible story angle available.
